name: alive-health-ug
description: Alive Health UG — single-service deploy (API + React)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && cross-env CI=true GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend
scripts.build:render: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && CI=true GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/copy-frontend.js
